title: One producer KV prefill fanned out to multiple target models
hypothesis: A single Pythia-70M producer prefill can be translated into useful target caches for both Pythia-160M and SmolLM2-135M using one pooled global affine map plus compact target-role gain/bias coordinates; counting the producer prefill once should beat two independent native target prefills in summed one-token handoff latency while keeping each target within +1 nat of native NLL.
prior_art_boundary: PA236/PA239 establish cross-model cache transfer and prefill reuse as existing methods. This screen uses ordinary unweighted affine ridge and does not reproduce CacheBridge, Universal Context-Reuse, or MoT.

data.old_content_exclusion: Exclude every top-level article title and exact row in all Wikitext-2 raw-v1 splits, plus every title/text hash reserved in MA-883.
data.article_partition: Whole article titles by int(SHA256(title)[:8],16) mod 4; bucket 0 development and buckets 1/2/3 fresh seeds 10883/10889/10897.
data.prompt_alignment: Require identical character-offset tokenization and equal token count among producer and both targets; use the same text rows for both consumers.
data.split: 24 map-fit prompts, 8 check prompts, 16 test prompts per bucket.
data.eligibility: 16-128 tokens, unique text; title/text hashes disjoint from MA-883 and from other buckets.

fixed_design.producer: Run Pythia-70M prefill once per prompt; this canonical K/V state supplies both target mappings.
fixed_design.layer_alignment: Nearest relative source-layer index for each target layer.
fixed_design.head_alignment: Nearest relative producer attention-head index for each target KV head.
fixed_design.rope: Remove source and target RoPE from key vectors before fitting; restore each target RoPE before replay.
fixed_design.shared_physical_map: One pooled 65x64 affine map shared over both targets and all target roles, fit on calibration rows.
fixed_design.target_view_code: Per-target-role scalar output gain and 64D bias fitted by closed-form least squares.
fixed_design.fresh_fit: Each fresh bucket refits maps/codes only on its own 24 calibration prompts; no dev weights are reused.
fixed_design.runtime_gate: Target identity selects fixed role coordinates; no target-NLL or hidden cache-quality gate.

controls: Native target prefill and one-token target replay for both targets
One global affine map per target architecture without role coordinates
One pooled global affine map plus per-target-role gain/bias (candidate)
success_gate: Across all six fresh target×seed conditions, candidate NLL is <= native +1.0 nat; in each seed summed source-prefill-once + both target translations + both target replays is faster than two native target prefills+replays; complete serialized translator payload <=25% of independent full-ridge mapper payload.
failure_gate: Any quality, summed-latency, or mapper-byte gate failure. Also fail Mirror-specific attribution if candidate does not improve the joint quality/bytes/latency frontier over the target-global affine control.

storage.system_storage: Report producer, both target checkpoints, and mapper payload bytes separately; producer checkpoint is an added system object, not free.

measurements: summed native and fanout wall time

scope: One Pythia-70M source, two target models, one-token next-token replay, article-heldout Wikitext-103-train prompts.
No multi-token decoding, other model pairs, GPU throughput, CacheBridge/MoT equivalence, or general cross-model semantics.
